VI.description: Save all ten accessors the scripter left in memory to the class's own directory, then save the class itself. Each VI is reopened by its QUALIFIED NAME through the IDE's application instance - a name-based Open VI Reference needs that reference, or it returns error 1004 and asks for a path. The destination is built as NI's provider builds it: the class's Path, Strip Path for the directory, Build Path with the file name. Save All This Library runs last, and only works once every member has a path; while any is unsaved it returns error 43, operation cancelled, because LabVIEW wants to prompt and cannot.
